meta.name: ERCOT 2026-09-20 (actual MIS data)
meta.notes: Observations are actual ERCOT MIS data. publishedAt is the MIS posting instant (US/Central converted to UTC). DAM_HOURLY rows are final day-ahead clearing values posted the day before delivery; RTM_15MIN rows are interim real-time settlement values subject to ERCOT correction; RTM_HOURLY rows are the hourly settlement series aggregated per ERCOT's equal-time rule over the four intervals.
